newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Hollandia plans Dfl 50 mln placement.
newsitem.headline: Hollandia plans Dfl 50 mln placement.

text.p: Dutch industrial investment firm Hollandia Industriele Maatschappij NV (HIM) will raise more than 50 million guilders in a private share placement aimed at institutions, arranger ABN AMRO Rothschild said on Friday.
It said the Lubbers family, the majority shareholder in HIM, would also sell up to 250,000 of its ordinary HIM shares, with a current market value of about 16 million guilders.

The placement is to partly fund HIM's purchase of Furness, which has activities in car dealerships, port activities and logistics, from tank storage and shipping group Pakhoed NV, for 95 million guilders cash.
The family owns 78 percent of the company's 600,000 issued shares, which closed at 66.50 guilders each.
ABN AMRO Rothschild said the price of the offering would be announced after the close of subscriptions, which was expected to occur within two weeks.
A bookbuilding process will be used for the offering, in which institutions can indicate the number of HIM shares they want and at what price.
The new shareholders will be entitled to dividends from the end of fiscal year 1997. No final dividend was expected to be distributed for 1996.
